encounters.weakness: Sulfuric Flask (acidic liquid) – deals 2x damage to enemies that use liquid-based attacks or emit crackling noises. The Stuttering Flask makes a wet, hiccuping sound when it moves, mimicking a bubbling cauldron. It attacks with splashing liquid that corrodes surfaces and damages the player's alchemical tools.

Mute Vial (Silence Agent) – If the player uses the Mute Vial, the golem's breathing attack is silenced. It cannot emit the 'breath wave' that pushes players back and damages their stamina. This is a critical defensive tool, as the golem moves slowly but inflicts status effects (slow, frostbite) over time.

Ceremonial Alchemy Torch — if the player uses the torch *while the boss is in its 'Still Form' (a state triggered when the player has not attacked for 10 seconds), the torch causes a chain reaction that destabilizes the boss's core. This causes it to emit a burst of weak flame, reducing its health by 30% and interrupting its next attack cycle. The boss only enters this state if the player has used the torch at least once during the encounter. Otherwise, it is immune to torch-based effects.
Pyroflame Ball (direct fire attack)
Ash Core Fragment (when active)
Ignition Key (only works if 2+ fire spells used in last 30 seconds and ritual performed in 3m range)

Shadow Dagger (Player's weapon) - The weapon emits a pulse of dark energy that temporarily blinds the Whisperer. Use the Shadow Dagger in a short burst to stun it for 3 seconds, reducing damage by 50% during the stun.

Crimson Residue (pickup from previous encounter) - When the Crimson Residue is active, the Hollow Man becomes momentarily transparent and vulnerable for 5 seconds. The player must be in a shadowed zone to trigger this — the man will flicker in and out of visibility, and if the player uses the Crimson Residue effect, he will freeze for 5 seconds, making him vulnerable to the Shadow Dagger or melee attack.

Echo Fragment (pickup from previous encounter) - When the Echo Fragment is active, the Shattered Watcher emits a low, dissonant hum that disrupts its internal system. The player must hold the Echo Fragment near the enemy's chest to trigger a 10-second vulnerability window. During this time, the enemy's vision is clouded, and it cannot detect movement. The Shadow Dagger becomes 2x damage during this window, and the player can attack with full accuracy.
Thermal Compound Rifle (fire-based rounds ignite its core circuitry).
Cold-Flame Rounds (the rounds create localized thermal spikes that disrupt its internal cold stabilization).
Wet Memory Fragment (when placed in a specific data terminal, it disrupts the entity's hallucinatory form and reveals its true identity).

The player's cracked bone staff deals 2x damage to this enemy. The staff was found in a collapsed sarcophagus during the first encounter. It glows faintly when used, and the enemy shudders when struck by it.

The Echo of the Warden is vulnerable to the Cracked Bone Staff, but only when the staff is used in a 'ritual chant'—a special animation that must be triggered via the player's inventory menu. The staff must be equipped and held over the enemy to activate the chant, which causes a burst of bone-shattering sound. This is revealed as a side effect of using the staff on the first enemy.

The Hollow Heart is vulnerable to the Flicker Fragment. When the player uses the Flicker Fragment during battle, time slows for 1 second, and the enemy's movements are visibly slowed—making it possible to strike twice. The Flicker Fragment was acquired during the second encounter. This weakness is only revealed when the player uses it for the first time against the boss.
Ferrous Gouge (the weapon inflicts 200% extra damage when swung at a minimum of 3 times in a row).
Crimson Filament (when used, the Wraith is stunned for 3 seconds and takes 250% extra damage from the Ferrous Gouge).
inventory: Crimson Filament (Shard of the First Pulse)

encounters.weakness: Black Oil (the boss is paralyzed for 4 seconds upon direct hit by the Ferrous Gouge after the player has used Black Oil. During this time, the player can deal 200% damage).
inventory: Crimson Filament (Shard of the First Pulse)

encounters.weakness: player_weapon: Baton (must be used to strike, prevents passive damage)
pickup: Flickering Light (must be activated to blind the enemy)
pickup: Patient Journal (must be read aloud to expose a quote that breaks the enemy's control)
Mirror Staff (reflects light, blinds enemy for 1 second, making it vulnerable to attack)
Floating Lantern (glow distracts and confuses the gnome, causing it to stutter and freeze for 3 seconds)
Shattered Mirror (held at eye level, it causes the puppet to 'melt' and break into static fragments, reducing health by 20%)

Steam Wrench (direct hit to steam vent causes 30% damage reduction and a 2-second disable on its main piston). The attack is triggered when the player uses the Steam Wrench on the enemy's vent port. The Scuttler fires a steam burst if not disabled in 3 seconds.

Cracked Gear Core (placing it on a piston trigger disables the trap for 4 seconds and causes the Punks to hesitate. They move slowly and can be targeted with a single precise Steam Wrench strike to disable their momentum). The Punks use three piston-based traps: one at each corner of the chamber. If a trap is disabled by Cracked Gear Core, the Punks freeze for 3 seconds.

Synchronized Gear Set (a single gear-rotation attack applied while the gear set is active causes 120% damage, instantly disables the machine's power cycle, and forces it into a vulnerable state for 10 seconds). The machine has 3 phases: erratic movement, overheat, and final surge. Only one weak point exists — the central cog. The player must insert the Synchronized Gear Set into the cog slot to trigger the attack. Without it, the machine resists all damage.

The Chrono-Engine Pistol's Steam Core Overload (requires 30+ charge from player weapon). When the player's weapon is at full charge and fires in a specific sequence, it causes a resonance that briefly disables the enemy. This is only possible if the player has used the Chrono-Engine Pistol at least once and the weapon is charged to 70%+ in the current encounter. Failure results in the enemy escaping into the next corridor with a hidden energy surge, setting up the next encounter.

Exposed to the Steam Resonance Fragment's energy field. When the player uses the fragment to activate a 'Vibration Burst' (a mechanic triggered only when the fragment is held and the player is within 3 meters of the enemy), the enemy is staggered for 3 seconds. This can only be done if the player has already used the Steam Resonance Fragment in the prior encounter. The Viper's body emits pulses that can be predicted and interrupted using the fragment's timing system, but if the player misses, it gains a 'Pulse Lock' that prevents movement for 2 seconds and increases damage by 30%.

The Phase-Shift Gear must be used *in sequence* with the Steam Resonance Fragment. When the player fires a Chrono-Engine Pistol shot *immediately after* activating the Phase-Shift Gear and holds the Steam Resonance Fragment, it creates a 'Temporal Echo' that briefly reverses the enemy's next attack. This is the only known way to disrupt the Sentinel's time-loop behavior. If not used within 1.2 seconds, the attack becomes irreversible and the Sentinel gains a 'Reality Fracture' state, increasing damage by 50% and reducing player health regen by 30%.

Damages the player's Steam-Siphon Flask when hit with a hot steam burst. Flasks are weak to hot steam, which is a byproduct of the Gloop's own body. The player must use a Steam-Flask Tweak (a pickup) to neutralize the effect.

The Wobble's joints are made of shaky brass. When struck by the Steam-Flask Tweak (used in prior encounter), its movements become erratic and slow. This allows the player to dodge 30% of attacks and deal double damage during its next turn.

Professor Pneuma's core is powered by a corrupted alchemical recipe — the *Steam-Flask Tweak* (from the first encounter) was used to stabilize his original form. If the player uses the Ticking Watch Fragment to 'freeze time' during the final attack, the core collapses and he becomes vulnerable to the Steam-Siphon Flask's hot steam burst, which deals 40% extra damage to his weak core. This requires precise timing and the correct order of pickups.
Steam-Siphon Blade (steam-siphon effect triggers steam bursts, weakening enforcer by 30% and increasing attack frequency by 50%)

Screwed-Up Gear Core (must be placed directly into the mechanical eye. If not used within 8 seconds of detection, the sentinel activates a Resonance Burst that inflicts 150% damage and freezes the player for 5 seconds).
Screwed-Up Gear Core (only usable in the final battle. If not used within the 5-second tick window, the Guardian activates a 'Final Steam Surge' that kills the player instantly)
Thunderclaw Gauntlet (direct lightning bolt attack)
Storm-Resonance Shard (used during direct attack)
Condensate Core (used during storm burst to hit vulnerable node; must be timed precisely)
Time-Slowing (Player Weapon) — when the player uses the Chronometer to slow time, the enemy's movement and attacks are frozen for 2 seconds. Can't move, can't attack during freeze frame.

Time-Reflector Shard — if the player activates the shard during an attack, the enemy's next move is reflected back. Enemy reverts to a previous state (e.g., earlier position, frozen state), creating a time loop. This can be used only once per encounter.
Time-Reflector Shard (acquired from second encounter)

Brass Geomantic Compass (player weapon) - emits tectonic pulse that disrupts its internal gears. When compass is activated, the Gorgon freezes for 3 seconds, allowing player to strike twice before it reactivates with 20% increased damage upon recovery. Use compass to disable it, then exploit its instability to strike before it reboots. Failure results in gear shrapnel damage to player's feet (20% health loss).

Fractured Geode Shard (picked up from previous encounter) - when the shard is used, the Golem's rusted body temporarily liquefies into a fluid form for 5 seconds. During this state, it becomes vulnerable to crushing attacks and gravity-based pushes. The shard must be held in hand during activation. If the shard is lost, the Golem gains a resist to crushing damage and grows a new limb (10% faster regeneration).

Silt-Infused Crystalline Core (picked up from prior encounter) - when the core is used, the Silt Sentinel's body fractures and becomes semi-transparent for 5 seconds. During this, it is completely vulnerable to crushing and seismic attacks. The core must be held during use. If used prematurely or without proper timing, the core detonates, causing a 3-second explosion that deals 120 damage to the player and triggers the boss spawn with a 30-second delay. The core must be used in full combat with the Sentinel to reveal the boss location.
Aetheric Anvil (player's weapon - direct damage from hammer swing, sparks when used on drones)

Steam-Sealed Valve (pickup from first encounter). Valve must be inserted into gargoyle's chest cavity to activate vulnerability. Once inserted, its armor cracks and it takes 50% damage from player swings.

Steam-Sealed Valve (from first encounter). Must be placed in the central hub of the clock tower. After placement, the boss enters a state of 'clock reset' and becomes vulnerable to all attacks for 10 seconds. All attacks now deal +20% damage from Aetheric Anvil.
